scope: Re-review original numerical/control/engineering requirements and fix demonstrated software/analytical defects; no CAD/PCB/physical qualification claim

issues_found_and_corrected.problem: NaN named poses, invalid SI declarations and nonphysical model/control/gripper parameters could pass configuration loading or explicit-config construction.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Shared finite/domain/shape/unit validation now covers file loading and model constructors; runtime controller edits are checked before integration.

issues_found_and_corrected.problem: Default relative allclose tolerance admitted nonrigid last-row/rotation scaling errors.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Rigid-transform checks use absolute tolerances with rtol=0 before IK and SLERP.

issues_found_and_corrected.problem: Trajectory concatenation admitted position/velocity/acceleration jumps larger than its stated absolute tolerance.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Continuity checks use rtol=0; all trajectory records require finite (samples,6) arrays and strictly increasing finite times.

issues_found_and_corrected.problem: A radial quintic TCP approach to full extension can require divergent joint acceleration, although sampled output forced the endpoint acceleration to zero.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: MOVE L requires scaled sigma_min > 1e-3 by default at its start and every solved sample; failure recommends another path or MOVE J. The guard is a conservative numerical policy, not a continuous-motion certificate.

issues_found_and_corrected.problem: Nonfinite gain scaling or out-of-limit/malformed references entered the controller, and disabled integral modes accumulated an unused integrator.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Reject inadmissible inputs and leave the integral state zero when integral action is disabled.

issues_found_and_corrected.problem: A valid unloaded beam divided by zero in its yield ratio; reversing the load produced a negative strength ratio.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Keep signed deflection, use absolute nominal root stress and positive strength ratios, represent zero-stress ratio as JSON null; reject nonphysical section/material/load inputs.

issues_found_and_corrected.problem: Negative or nonfinite payload override was accepted by gravity loading.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Validate payload override as finite nonnegative kg.

issues_found_and_corrected.problem: Conceptual drive sizing reused control inertia assumptions below the same assumed COM point-mass inertia, undermining its conservative-model wording.
issues_found_and_corrected.correction: Use max(control inertia, all-angle sum(m*lever_bound^2)) for sizing while keeping the educational controller unchanged; test via independently differentiated COM kinetic energy.

remaining_model_limits: Local numerical IK exhaustion is not a complete reachability proof.
MOVE L singularity/derivative checks are sampled; no continuous collision or derivative certificate.
Control is an independent inertia/damping model, with no coupled rigid-body, gravity, drive-delay or contact dynamics.
Actuator diagonal inertia bounds cover assumed COM point masses; centroidal rotation tensors, coupling, Coriolis/centrifugal and reflected-drive inertias remain outside that model.
Payload and repeatability remain targets without physical hardware tests.
